name: Berry Blast
about: Berry Blast is a delightful herbal tea packed with the tangy and sweet flavors of mixed berries. This refreshing tea is perfect for both hot summer days and cozy evenings, offering a burst of natural antioxidants.

detailed_description.summary: Dive into the tangy and sweet world of Berry Blast, a fruit-infused herbal tea bursting with the goodness of berries and natural herbs. Perfect for energizing your mornings or enjoying a cool, refreshing iced tea in the afternoon.
benefits: Rich in antioxidants for combating free radicals.
A fruity, refreshing tea for any time of the day.
detailed_description.cautions: Consult your doctor before use if you are taking any medication or have a medical condition. Not recommended for children below 12 years.
detailed_description.ingredients: Hibiscus, Rosehips, Dried Berries, Natural Berry Flavor
detailed_description.instructions: Steep at 212°F for 5-7 minutes. Use 1–2 teaspoons or 1 tea sachet per 8 oz cup. Serve hot or iced with a touch of honey or lemon for added flavor.
detailed_description.size: 1.3 oz loose leaf or 15 tea sachets.

name: Black Tea
about: A traditional tea with a strong, bold flavor, Black Tea is an all-time favorite for its versatility and rich taste. It's perfect for starting your day or enjoying a relaxing afternoon break.

detailed_description.summary: Enjoy the classic boldness of Black Tea, a full-bodied beverage perfect for morning energy or an afternoon pick-me-up. With its rich flavor and high caffeine content, Black Tea is a versatile drink for tea lovers everywhere.
benefits: Rich in antioxidants that support heart health.
detailed_description.cautions: Avoid excessive consumption due to its high caffeine content. Consult a healthcare provider if you have sensitivities to caffeine.
detailed_description.instructions: Steep at 212°F for 3-5 minutes. Use 1 teaspoon per 8 oz cup. Add milk or sugar to taste for a traditional experience.
detailed_description.size: 2 oz loose leaf or 20 tea bags.

name: Breathe Well
about: Breathe Well is a soothing blend of herbs that promotes respiratory health and relaxation. This tea is a natural remedy for colds and congestion, offering a calming effect with every sip.

detailed_description.summary: Clear your mind and breathe deeply with Breathe Well Tea, a herbal blend designed to support respiratory health and relaxation. With its minty freshness and soothing ingredients, this tea is ideal for seasonal wellness or everyday calm.
benefits: Relieves congestion and supports respiratory health.
Soothes sore throat and reduces inflammation.
Promotes relaxation with its calming herbal blend.
detailed_description.cautions: Consult a healthcare provider if you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication. Not suitable for children under 12.
detailed_description.instructions: Steep at 212°F for 5-7 minutes. Use 1–2 teaspoons or 1 sachet per 8 oz cup. Serve hot for best results.
detailed_description.size: 1.3 oz loose leaf or 15 tea sachets.

name: Butterfly Pea
about: Butterfly Pea is a mesmerizing herbal tea known for its vibrant blue color that changes to purple with a squeeze of lemon. Enjoy its mild floral flavor and mood-enhancing properties.

detailed_description.summary: Butterfly Pea Tea is a captivating herbal tea with a vibrant blue hue and magical color-changing properties. A natural mood enhancer and antioxidant powerhouse, this tea is as beneficial as it is beautiful.
benefits: Loaded with antioxidants to promote overall wellness.
detailed_description.cautions: Not recommended for pregnant or nursing women. Consult your doctor if taking any medications.
detailed_description.instructions: Steep at 185°F for 3-5 minutes. Use 1 teaspoon per 8 oz cup. Add lemon juice to witness the color transformation.
detailed_description.size: 1 oz loose leaf or 10 tea sachets.

name: Chamomile
about: Chamomile is a timeless herbal tea known for its calming properties and delicate floral flavor. It's the ideal choice for unwinding after a long day or preparing for a restful sleep.

detailed_description.summary: Unwind with Chamomile Tea, a gentle herbal blend renowned for its calming properties and sweet, floral flavor. Perfect for bedtime, this tea is a soothing companion for relaxation and rest.
benefits: Soothes digestive issues and supports gut health.
detailed_description.cautions: Consult a doctor before use if you are allergic to flowers in the daisy family. Not recommended for children under 12.
detailed_description.instructions: Steep at 212°F for 5-7 minutes. Use 1–2 teaspoons or 1 sachet per 8 oz cup. Enjoy plain or with honey for added sweetness.
detailed_description.size: 1.5 oz loose leaf or 15 tea sachets.
